title: Basic
description: The swatch opens the popover: area, hue and opacity sliders, format select and eyedropper. The text value stays in the field, always available for typing.

title: Formats and brand swatches
description: Preset colors in the popover. The format select switches the text between HEX, RGB, HSL and OKLCH; format sets the starting one.

title: Validation and disabled
description: The error is linked to the text value. Without alpha every value is opaque. Disabled uses the sunken surface.
